# Pre-action state transition pre-check & action plan composition
threshold = 4.2
# re-fetch cart and wish list to ensure fresh state
cart_res = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
c_items = cart_res['cart_items']
wish_res = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)

wish_before_list = wish_res if isinstance(wish_res, list) else wish_res.get('cart_items', [])

# Build mapping pid->quantity from cart
cart_qty = {ci['product_id']: ci['quantity'] for ci in c_items}

# Determine which pids meet rating criterion (under threshold)
target = []
for pid in cart_qty.keys():
    prod = apis.amazon.show_product(product_id=pid)
    if prod['rating'] < threshold:
        target.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': cart_qty[pid], 'product_name': prod['name'], 'rating': prod['rating']})

# Already in wish list check
wish_ids = set([w['product_id'] for w in wish_before_list])
need_action = [t for t in target if t['product_id'] not in wish_ids]
already_in_target_state = [t['product_id'] for t in target if t['product_id'] in wish_ids]

print('wish_list_before:', wish_before_list)
print('Already in target state:', already_in_target_state, f"({len(already_in_target_state)})")
print('Need action product_ids:', [t['product_id'] for t in need_action], f"({len(need_action)})")

print('\nACTION PLAN (move from cart to wish list)')
for t in need_action:
    print({'product_id': t['product_id'], 'product_name': t['product_name'], 'rating': t['rating'], 'quantity': t['quantity']})

# Execute move actions from cart to wish list for computed target items
moves = []
for t in need_action:
    pid = t['product_id']
    qty = t['quantity']
    try:
        res = apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(product_id=pid, quantity=qty, access_token=access_token)
        moves.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': qty, 'status': 'ok', 'response': res})
    except Exception as e:
        moves.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': qty, 'status': 'fail', 'error': str(e)})

print('Move results:')
for m in moves:
    print(m)
print('Succeeded:', sum(1 for m in moves if m['status']=='ok'), 'Failed:', sum(1 for m in moves if m['status']=='fail'))

# Post-action verification
threshold = 4.2
target_ids = [40, 943, 1283, 2428, 2514]

cart_after_items = cart_after['cart_items']

wish_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
wish_after_items = wish_after if isinstance(wish_after, list) else wish_after.get('cart_items', [])
wish_after_ids = [w['product_id'] for w in wish_after_items]

print('Cart after item IDs:', cart_after_ids)
print('Wish list after item IDs:', wish_after_ids)

in_wish = [pid for pid in target_ids if pid in wish_after_ids]
left_in_cart = [pid for pid in target_ids if pid in cart_after_ids]
missing_in_wish = [pid for pid in target_ids if pid not in wish_after_ids]
print('Target IDs:', target_ids)
print('In wish list:', in_wish, f"({len(in_wish)})")
print('Left in cart:', left_in_cart, f"({len(left_in_cart)})")
print('Missing in wish list:', missing_in_wish, f"({len(missing_in_wish)})")
